name: Aquilifer (Vacant — Metellus Dead)
notes: VACANT. The previous Aquilifer was Gaius Metellus. He died in the excavation. The Aquila eagle standard is currently locked in the sacellum. The role is ritually significant and unfilled.
gm_notes: Corvinus needed someone holding this role who will follow orders before taking religious initiative. Metellus's death was not officially explained. DC 13 Medicine (examining the body if available): cause of death is not consistent with an accident. DC 15 History: Aquiliferi dying outside combat is extremely rare -- the eagle is sacred. The vacant role creates a ritual problem: the unit cannot formally march under the eagle without a designated bearer. If a player takes this role (or if an NPC is assigned), the Aquila standard becomes a plot object.
